title: Fundamentals of Quantum Machine Learning and Robustness
summary: Quantum machine learning (QML) sits at the intersection of quantum computing and classical machine learning, offering the prospect of new computational paradigms and advantages for processing complex data. This chapter introduces the fundamentals of QML for readers from both communities, establishing a shared conceptual foundation. We connect the worst-case, adversarial perspective from theoretical computer science with the physical principles of quantum systems, highlighting how superposition, entanglement, and measurement collapse influence learning and robustness.
